why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items and neither is broken. Item 1: the builder brief does say to wrap JSON.parse in try/catch, but only to throw a new error: "throw a new error (do not return `{}`, the defaults or any other value)". It never tells the builder to catch the error and return a value. Item 2: verifier Check 2 accepts line 3 and column 3 "in any readable form (e.g. `line 3 column 3`, `3:3`, `line 3, col 3`)". Its grep calls only look for `bad config:` and the path. It FAILs only if a required element is missing or wrong, not because the wording or order differs from one exact format.
